rule: MetadataArtifactId = "sha256:" + lowercase_hex(SHA-256(exact_metadata_bytes)) (design section 2). For a PM block, the exact bytes are the JSON object text between the pm-metadata markers with one opening fence line and its closing fence line removed and leading/trailing ASCII whitespace trimmed. For a metadata file, the exact bytes are the file bytes unchanged.
